travel.description: Business travel-related expenses including airfare, trains, taxis, car rentals, and hotels.
travel.notes: Flights must be economy/coach class. Rail in 2nd class/coach class only. Car rentals limited to compact category (full-size only if 3+ travelers). Room upgrades only if at no additional cost. Fines and damages not reimbursable. Mileage reimbursement follows local law (e.g., IRS in US).

transportation.notes: Fuel reimbursable for rental/personal car if approved. Parking/traffic fines are not reimbursable.

meals.description: Personal meal expenses during SAP-approved overnight business trips.
meals.notes: Receipts required. Alcohol not reimbursable. Meal reimbursement depends on duration of trip (2–3 meals reimbursable depending on trip length). Example limits: US ($15 breakfast, $20 lunch, $40 dinner; $75 daily), Outside US (€15 breakfast, €20 lunch, €30 dinner; €65 daily). Grocery receipts allowed if in extended lodging.

entertainment.notes: Requires advance manager approval. Must be clearly business-related.

office_expenses.notes: Electronics or IT-related equipment require IT approval.

communications.notes: Must be business-related. Personal usage not reimbursable.

extraordinary_expenses.notes: Only reimbursable with written pre-approval from SAP Line of Business Owner and cost center owner. No partial reimbursements allowed if policy not followed.

personal_expenses.notes: Strictly non-reimbursable. Includes personal leisure, alcohol, or any expenses unrelated to SAP business.
